metric: Modelled total financial impact, M&S and Co-op combined event
comparable_note: A single modelled event cost, not an incident count. Directly comparable with the curated impact figures in this tool.
method: Independent modelling by the CMC using consumer spend data from Fable Data, covering lost sales for the retailers, franchisees and suppliers, plus response, restoration, legal and notification costs. Categorised as a Category 2 systemic event.
notes: Range £270m-£440m; median £355m. Excludes ransom payments, none indicated. M&S separately guided to about £300m.
